reference_use: Owner-approved LW-CAR-0022 for exact S2 look, type and ending. New swap layout is defined by this task; all copy from copy.json v1.0.
font_family: REF-008 look: heavy tight grotesk for headlines, clean sans for body, italic for tier lines
next_action: Owner reviews all generated slides at the end of Batch A.
caption: caption.txt

remote_save.method: One complete-carousel commit and immediate push under BATCH-A.md.

slides.prompt:
Create ONE finished Harda S2 portrait carousel slide, 1080 x 1350, 4:5. Match the supplied approved LW-CAR-0022 reference for exact heavy tight lowercase grotesk headlines, clean regular sans body, realistic WHITE/LIGHT-GREY anatomical mannequin, bald and faceless, fine grey shading, opaque black #2A2A2A shorts, featureless smooth pelvis, and black/grey equipment. Use its LOOK ONLY and replace ALL words, poses and layout with the instructions below. Adult athletic male mannequin as in the approved series. Solid opaque CLEAN #F0F1EB background, no texture or arch. Text dark #2A2A2A, grey #6B6B6B, flat coral #F26445 markers. Only the expressly named target muscles on the GOOD exercise figure are coral; all other muscles white/light-grey, never sand or green. Keep the ENTIRE TOP 110px empty for the real logo. Do not generate a logo, wordmark, watermark, signature, counter, progress bar, panel, border or extra text. The actual transparent Harda logo will be inserted at x=48,y=19,size=218x71. Keep all supplied lowercase strings, hyphens and punctuation exact and fully visible. The requested faded figure is a faded appearance on the solid off-white background, not transparent output.

COVER. Two centered headline lines below the logo space, same heavy tight lowercase typography and marker treatment as the approved cover. Exact text and lines:
stop doing this.
do this instead
Put a flat coral #F26445 marker behind ONLY `do this instead`. Keep the exact period after the first line; no period after the second. No subtitle or other words. Lower half: TWO white/light-grey anatomical mannequins side by side, full bodies/equipment visible and on the same baseline. LEFT figure faded to about 40% opacity in appearance, performing a standing barbell upright row, front view, elbows high, bar to chest height, with a round dark #2A2A2A badge containing white `✗`. RIGHT figure fully visible, performing standing dumbbell lateral raise with arms at shoulder height, front view, ONLY both side delts highlighted coral, with a round coral #F26445 badge containing a white `✓`. Keep both badges distinct and clear, and all figures/equipment below the title without overlap. Both wear opaque black shorts. No other labels.

export.logo: Official transparent logo composited at x=48,y=19,size=218x71; no background patch.
